text_markup: One card, {card:Showing Off}, allows the Runner to access cards from the bottom of R&D. While this effect applies, candidates in the Corp's deck are presented working up from the bottom: treat {ref:rule_candidates_in_rnd} as if it said "bottom" instead of "top" and {ref:rule_rnd_topmost_eligibile_candidate} as if it said "bottommost" instead of "topmost".
text_plain: One card, Showing Off, allows the Runner to access cards from the bottom of R&D. While this effect applies, candidates in the Corp's deck are presented working up from the bottom: treat rule 7.4.1c as if it said "bottom" instead of "top" and rule 7.4.7a as if it said "bottommost" instead of "topmost".
